title: UK’s Burnham won’t invite Putin to G20 summit next year; he skips them anyway
summary_full: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham confirmed that Vladimir Putin would not be invited to the 2027 G20 summit. This comes amid the intensified Russia-Ukraine war. However, the US has invited Putin to this year's G20, which has drawn criticism from European leaders. Russia continues to attend G20 meetings, though Putin doesn't attend in person.
